record.bible_text: When Ephraim<WH0669> spake<WH01696><WTH8763> trembling<WH07578>, he exalted<WH05375><WTH8804> himself in Israel<WH03478>; but when he offended<WH0816><WTH8799> in Baal<WH01168>, he died<WH04191><WTH8799>.

And now they sin<WH02398><WTH8800> more and more<WH03254><WTH8686>, and have made<WH06213><WTH8799> them molten images<WH04541> of their silver<WH03701>, <FI>and<Fi> idols<WH06091> according to their own understanding<WH08394>, all of it the work<WH04639> of the craftsmen<WH02796>: they say<WH0559><WTH8802> of them, Let the men<WH0120> that sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8802> kiss<WH05401><WTH8799> the calves<WH05695>. <RF>they sin...: Heb. they add to sin<Rf> <RF>the men...: or, the sacrificers of men<Rf>

Therefore they shall be as the morning<WH01242> cloud<WH06051>, and as the early<WH07925><WTH8688> dew<WH02919> that passeth away<WH01980><WTH8802>, as the chaff<WH04671> <FI>that<Fi> is driven with the whirlwind<WH05590><WTH8792> out of the floor<WH01637>, and as the smoke<WH06227> out of the chimney<WH0699>.

Yet I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> from the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>, and thou shalt know<WH03045><WTH8799> no god<WH0430> but me<WH02108>: for <FI>there is<Fi> no saviour<WH03467><WTH8688> beside me<WH01115>.<CM>
I did know<WH03045><WTH8804> thee in the wilderness<WH04057>, in the land<WH0776> of great drought<WH08514>. <RF>great...: Heb. droughts<Rf>

According to their pasture<WH04830>, so were they filled<WH07646><WTH8799>; they were filled<WH07646><WTH8804>, and their heart<WH03820> was exalted<WH07311><WTH8799>; therefore have they forgotten<WH07911><WTH8804> me.
Therefore I will be unto them as a lion<WH07826>: as a leopard<WH05246> by the way<WH01870> will I observe<WH07789><WTH8799> <FI>them<Fi> :

I will meet<WH06298><WTH8799> them as a bear<WH01677> <FI>that is<Fi> bereaved<WH07909> <FI>of her whelps<Fi> , and will rend<WH07167><WTH8799> the caul<WH05458> of their heart<WH03820>, and there will I devour<WH0398><WTH8799> them like a lion<WH03833>: the wild<WH07704> beast<WH02416> shall tear<WH01234><WTH8762> them. <RF>wild...: Heb. beast of the field<Rf><CM>
O Israel<WH03478>, thou hast destroyed<WH07843><WTH8765> thyself; but in me <FI>is<Fi> thine help<WH05828>. <RF>is...: Heb. in thy help<Rf>

I will<WH0165> be thy king<WH04428>: where<WH0645> <FI>is any other<Fi> that may save<WH03467><WTH8686> thee in all thy cities<WH05892>? and thy judges<WH08199><WTH8802> of whom thou saidst<WH0559><WTH8804>, Give<WH05414><WTH8798> me a king<WH04428> and princes<WH08269>? <RF>I will...: rather, Where is thy king?<Rf>
I gave<WH05414><WTH8799> thee a king<WH04428> in mine anger<WH0639>, and took<WH03947><WTH8799> <FI>him<Fi> away in my wrath<WH05678>.
The iniquity<WH05771> of Ephraim<WH0669> <FI>is<Fi> bound up<WH06887><WTH8803>; his sin<WH02403> <FI>is<Fi> hid<WH06845><WTH8803>.

The sorrows<WH02256> of a travailing woman<WH03205><WTH8802> shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> upon him: he <FI>is<Fi> an unwise<WH02450> son<WH01121>; for he should not stay<WH05975><WTH8799> long<WH06256> in <FI>the place of<Fi> the breaking forth<WH04866> of children<WH01121>. <RF>long: Heb. a time<Rf>

I will ransom<WH06299><WTH8799> them from the power<WH03027> of the grave<WH07585>; I will redeem<WH01350><WTH8799> them from death<WH04194>: O death<WH04194>, I will<WH0165> be thy plagues<WH01698>; O grave<WH07585>, I will<WH0165> be thy destruction<WH06987>: repentance<WH05164> shall be hid<WH05641><WTH8735> from mine eyes<WH05869>. <RF>power: Heb. hand<Rf>

Though he be fruitful<WH06500><WTH8686> among <FI>his<Fi> brethren<WH0251>, an east wind<WH06921> shall come<WH0935><WTH8799>, the wind<WH07307> of the LORD<WH03068> shall come up<WH05927><WTH8802> from the wilderness<WH04057>, and his spring<WH04726> shall become dry<WH0954><WTH8799>, and his fountain<WH04599> shall be dried up<WH02717><WTH8799>: he shall spoil<WH08154><WTH8799> the treasure<WH0214> of all pleasant<WH02532> vessels<WH03627>. <RF>pleasant...: Heb. vessels of desire<Rf>

Samaria<WH08111> shall become desolate<WH0816><WTH8799>; for she hath rebelled<WH04784><WTH8804> against her God<WH0430>: they shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799> by the sword<WH02719>: their infants<WH05768> shall be dashed in pieces<WH07376><WTH8792>, and their women with child<WH02030> shall be ripped up<WH01234><WTH8792>.<CM>
